description:
We are EAGLES, a passionate team of technology enthusiasts participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Casablanca, Morocco.

Our team brings together creativity, software engineering, and problem-solving skills to develop innovative solutions for real-world space exploration challenges.

Through collaboration and technology, we aim to contribute to safer and more sustainable human space missions.
summary:
AstroHealth is an interactive astronaut health monitoring and mission simulation platform developed by Team EAGLES for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to radiation, isolation, altered gravity, and physical and psychological stress. AstroHealth addresses these challenges through a unified platform for exploring astronaut health and mission conditions.

The platform features simulated monitoring of heart rate, oxygen saturation, sleep, stress, fatigue, workload, and radiation exposure. It combines real-time simulation dashboards, an interactive Mars mission simulator, a 3D astronaut digital twin, explainable risk alerts, short-term trend analysis, and a mission command center.

NASA Open Science Data Repository studies provide a separate scientific evidence layer, connecting the demonstration to spaceflight-related biological research.

AstroHealth aims to make astronaut health risks easier to understand and explore. All physiological telemetry is synthetic, and the prototype is not a clinically validated medical system.
details:
AstroHealth — Project Details

1. Project Overview

AstroHealth is an interactive astronaut health monitoring and mission simulation platform developed by Team EAGLES to explore health and operational challenges during long-duration space missions.

Our solution combines simulated physiological telemetry, mission scenarios, health analytics, scientific research references, and an interactive 3D astronaut representation.

2. How AstroHealth Works

AstroHealth uses a JavaScript-based simulation engine powered by Cloudflare Pages Functions to generate synthetic astronaut health and mission indicators. Cloudflare D1 provides persistent storage for mission sessions and simulation data.

The React dashboard displays simulated health indicators through interactive charts, real-time visualizations, and an interactive 3D astronaut digital twin.

The platform includes:

  • Astronaut Health: Monitoring of heart rate, oxygen saturation, sleep, stress, fatigue, workload, and radiation indicators.
  • Live Monitoring: Continuously updated simulated telemetry and historical charts.
  • Mars Mission Simulator: Mission phases, adjustable simulation speed, and environmental scenarios.
  • 3D Digital Twin: An interactive astronaut model linked to simulated health indicators.
  • Risk Alerts: Explainable notifications based on demonstration thresholds.
  • Health Analytics: Experimental trend estimates and anomaly detection.
  • Mission Intelligence: Mission readiness scoring, scenario comparisons, event history, and data exports.
  • Mission Command Center: Interactive emergency scenarios, response actions, and simulated communication delays.
  • Guided Demo: A reproducible walkthrough of the platform's main features.

3. NASA Scientific Evidence

AstroHealth includes a separate scientific evidence section referencing NASA research resources and studies from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), including OSD-202.

OSD-202 examines biological effects associated with simulated microgravity and low-dose radiation in mice. This study provides research context rather than direct astronaut medical telemetry.

NASA research observations are kept separate from the platform's synthetic simulation data.

4. Technologies Used

Frontend: React, JavaScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Lucide Icons.

Backend: JavaScript, Cloudflare Pages Functions, and Cloudflare Workers Runtime.

Database: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) for persistent mission sessions and simulation data.

Development & Testing: Git, GitHub, Node.js, Playwright, automated testing, and AI-assisted development using OpenAI Codex.

Deployment: Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Pages Functions.

5. Innovation and Impact

AstroHealth brings mission simulation, health monitoring, scientific evidence, and interactive decision exploration into one accessible application.

Its interactive scenarios allow users to observe how simulated health indicators change under different mission conditions and explore potential responses.

The platform is designed for education, demonstration, and further research exploration. It does not use real astronaut medical records or provide clinically validated diagnoses or medical recommendations.

6. Project Access

Live Application: https://astrohealth-eagles.pages.dev

Source Code: https://github.com/ANASS-AZYZ/AstroHealth
